$comment: Pinned wordlists baked into bw-sandbox (IMAGE-006, #604). Each list is vendored under infra/docker/sandbox/wordlists/<category>/ and verified by its sha256 at build time by tools/install-wordlists.mjs; a mismatch, a licence outside the allowlist, a non-UTF-8 file or a total above IMAGE_WORDLISTS_MAX_MIB fails the build. Paths are relative to this file. Every list and licence text must be recorded here; scripts/check-sandbox-wordlists.mjs fails on an unlisted file. Lists are curated for size: trim to the top-N entries in a reviewed change, never at build time.

lists.name: common
lists.use: ffuf and katana content discovery (common web paths)

lists.name: burp-parameter-names
lists.use: ffuf parameter discovery (common query and body parameter names)

lists.name: subdomains-top1million-5000
lists.use: ffuf subdomain prefix discovery (common subdomain labels)
